title: GDP report to give insight before Election Day. And, Israel's election is deadlocked
description: Economists expect the GDP report to show economic growth, but say that growth is "fragile." And, after 90% of the votes in Israel have been counted, no clear winner has emerged.

title: State ballots let voters decide on abortion, taxes, transgender restrictions
description: Missouri voters could ban abortion - after they just removed a ban two years ago. California voters could tax billionaires 5% of their wealth.

title: These are the House races to watch in the 2026 midterm election on Nov. 3
description: An NPR analysis finds 70 House districts where Democrats and Republicans are each investing more than six figures in advertising during the final few days of the election, including in deep red areas.

title: Support for Trump among white evangelicals has plummeted, polls reveal
description: Three new polls suggest that President Trump is losing ground among white evangelicals. What explains this drop — and will it affect the midterm elections?

title: Hackers expose the identities of more than 40,000 DHS employees
description: A group of hacktivists calling themselves Distributed Denial of Secrets, said the unmasking of ICE agents, DHS operatives and contractors was fair play, given the government's lack of transparency.

title: Judge denies the Justice Department's bid to stop processing California ballots
description: While the judge rejected the Department of Justice's unprecedented demand in California, the case isn't over yet. The federal government immediately filed notice that it will appeal.

title: A breakthrough for the group on the trail of Chinese hackers
description: Chinese government hackers are secretly burrowing into critical networks using creative new methods.

title: Israel's election too close to call. And, the Ebola outbreak reaches grim milestone
description: Israeli voters turned out in record numbers, and the results remain too close to call. And, more than 10,000 people have been infected with Ebola since the outbreak was first declared in May.

title: Senate candidates built up massive campaign war chests with out-of-state donations
description: In several competitive U.S. Senate contests, candidates have built healthy campaign accounts with out-of-state donations. But the messages to those donors is very different from the one back at home.

title: Why many student voters have a right to choose where to register to vote
description: Student voters studying outside their hometown have a right to choose where they register to vote. Advocates say a Montana legal fight is a reminder of a misunderstanding of those students' rights.
